title: Entries of a read segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ and $a,n\in\mathbb N$. For any index $i$ less than the length of the list whose entries are $\mu(a),\mu(a+1),\ldots,\mu(a+n-1)$, the entry at index $i$ is $\mu(a+i)$.
hypotheses_covered: The index $i$ is less than the length of the read-segment list
